title: Learned precedent
description: One precedent drawn from a case where a recommendation differed from the Release Team's decision. Precedents record observed practice and never outrank the review policy.

situation.description: The circumstances, general enough to recognise again but specific enough to mean something.

lesson.description: What the decision reveals about how the team weighs this kind of request. Empty when the comments explained nothing.

rationale_quote.description: Verbatim text from a Release Team comment. Shown to reviewers as the evidence for the precedent, so it must be checkable.

rationale_author.description: Launchpad username of the Release Team member quoted.

applies_when.description: Facets used to find this precedent again. Fewer keys means it applies more widely.
